rationale: The agent did not follow key policy steps. It appears to have only looked up one of the two emails provided, so it may not have acted on all of the user’s orders. It executed cancellations and a return without first confirming each order-changing action with the user. It also set a specific refund method (gift card) without confirmation. The user explicitly wanted to keep the loved boots unless an exchange to a cheaper identical pair was possible; there is no evidence the agent identified the boots, checked for cheaper identical replacements, or executed/confirmed an exchange. Finally, the agent did not provide the requested final outcome of how much money the user could get back today. These gaps indicate the request was not completed in line with the policy.
